concept.name: Illness
concept.description: The gradual permanent negative change from a healthy baseline to a chronically ill state with no natural return to full health. Distinct from GTCVI (temporary illness that resolves) — this represents conditions that permanently alter the baseline, e.g. developing a chronic condition.
concept.notes: ROM-GPCVN selected — chronic illness is a permanent negative change. The subject moves from healthy to a new permanently lower baseline. Contrast with temporary illness (GTCVI) which resolves. Example: developing diabetes, chronic pain, or long-term condition. Canonical parallel: Fresh→Rotten (food cannot return to freshness).
